newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: C.Amorim surges on hopes of good H1 result.
newsitem.headline: C.Amorim surges on hopes of good H1 result.

text.p: Portuguese cork company Corticeira Amorim surged 165 escudos to hit an all-time high of 2,290 escudos on expectations that it will post strong first-half results.
Traders said first half results are expected around the beginning of September.
"All the fuss is about Amorim's first-half profits which should be pretty positive. Volume is very thin though," said one dealer. By 1000 GMT 20,909 shares had changed hands.

Amorim surprised the market by announcing a pre-tax profit increase of 63 percent to 476 million escudos in the first quarter and analysts expect good results for the full year. The company's financial year runs from January to December.
